details: Package appears to distribute a platform-specific binary (frps linux-amd64) under a scoped npm name. Only two files were present in scope and no install-time execution, outbound network behavior, credential access, or persistence was observed. No lifecycle scripts, no fetch-and-execute patterns, no hardcoded exfiltration endpoints, and no reads of installer-side secret paths were identified. The package name and contents are consistent with a prebuilt-binary distribution of the frp reverse-proxy server for linux-amd64; the binary itself was not independently inspected within this record.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
